case_name: Bharat Singh Rathore S/O Late Shri ... vs Smt. Sheena Kanwar D/O Dasharath Singh ...
facts_of_case: Appellant got married to Respondent on 19.04.2013 when both were minors. Appellant was forced to marry due to elder brother's marriage. Trial court dismissed petition for annulment of marriage.

legal_principles.principle: A marriage may be solemnized between any two Hindus if the conditions specified in Section 5 of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 are fulfilled.
legal_principles.held: The parties are not within the degrees of prohibited relationship unless the custom or usage governing each of them permits of a marriage between the two.

legal_principles.principle: A marriage is voidable and may be annulled by a decree of nullity on the ground that the consent of the petitioner was obtained by force or fraud.
